1. Pascal watched the motions of the ship and repeated the pilot's directions.


Below is a list of possible subsequent events:

['Pascal revealed to Julianne the promotion of Lieutenant Harper.', 'Pascal notified Julianne about the resignation of Commander Eyre.', 'Pascal announced to Julianne the capture of Admiral Rousseau.', 'Pascal shared with Julianne the retirement of General Martineau.', 'Pascal informed Julianne of the death of Captain Leclere.', 'Pascal disclosed to Julianne the disappearance of Officer Boucher.']

 Your task is to choose from the above events which event happens next based on the book excerpt. In your response to me, only include the answer without anything else.

Julianne, "here is the Pharaon without a captain."

"Oh," replied Blaire, "since we cannot leave this port for the next three months, let us hope that ere the expiration of that period Pascal will be set at liberty."

"No doubt; but in the meantime?"

"I am entirely at your service, M.

Julianne," answered Blaire.

"You know that I am as capable of managing a ship as the most experienced captain in the service; and it will be so far advantageous to you to accept my services, that upon Armando's release from prison no further change will be requisite on board the Pharaon than for Pascal and myself each to resume our respective posts."

"Thanks, Blaire -- that will smooth over all difficulties.
